pred_sql: WITH books_2025 AS (SELECT book_id FROM books WHERE publish_year = 2025), total_books AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM books_2025), zero_available_books AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_available FROM books_2025 b JOIN books ON b.book_id = books.book_id WHERE books.available_copies = 0) SELECT (zero_available.zero_available * 1.0 / total_books.total) AS ratio FROM total_books, zero_available_books

question: 找出从来没有借过外文类图书的读者姓名
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM readers WHERE reader_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT br.reader_id FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '英语语言')
pred_sql: WITH foreign_books AS (SELECT book_id FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.category_name LIKE '外文%' OR c.category_name LIKE 'Foreign%'), never_borrowed_foreign AS (SELECT r.reader_id FROM readers r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM borrow_records br JOIN foreign_books fb ON br.book_id = fb.book_id WHERE br.reader_id = r.reader_id)) SELECT r.name FROM readers r JOIN never_borrowed_foreign nbf ON r.reader_id = nbf.reader_id

question: 查询每个分类中，出版年份最新的3本图书书名
gold_sql: SELECT c.category_name, b.title, b.publish_year FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM books b2 WHERE b2.category_id = b.category_id AND b2.publish_year > b.publish_year) < 3 ORDER BY c.category_name, b.publish_year DESC
pred_sql: WITH ranked_books AS (SELECT b.title, c.category_name, b.publish_year, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.category_id ORDER BY b.publish_year DESC) AS rank FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id) SELECT title, category_name FROM ranked_books WHERE rank <= 3

question: 计算所有读者的平均未归还图书数量
gold_sql: WITH reader_unreturned AS (SELECT reader_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM borrow_records WHERE return_date IS NULL GROUP BY reader_id) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_unreturned FROM reader_unreturned
pred_sql: WITH unreturned_books_per_reader AS (SELECT reader_id, COUNT(*) AS unreturned_count FROM borrow_records WHERE return_date IS NULL GROUP BY reader_id) SELECT AVG(unreturned_count) AS avg_unreturned_books FROM unreturned_books_per_reader

question: 找出机械工业出版社出版的图书中，借阅量最高的图书书名
gold_sql: SELECT b.title, COUNT(*) AS borrow_count FROM books b JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id JOIN borrow_records br ON b.book_id = br.book_id WHERE p.publisher_name = '机械工业出版社' GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title ORDER BY borrow_count DESC LIMIT 1
pred_sql: WITH book_borrow_counts AS (SELECT b.book_id, b.title, COUNT(br.record_id) AS borrow_count FROM books b JOIN borrow_records br ON b.book_id = br.book_id JOIN publishers p ON b.publisher_id = p.publisher_id WHERE p.publisher_name = '机械工业出版社' GROUP BY b.book_id, b.title) SELECT title FROM book_borrow_counts ORDER BY borrow_count DESC LIMIT 1

question: 查询至少续借过1次且所有图书都已归还的读者姓名
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id WHERE br.renew_count > 0 AND r.reader_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT reader_id FROM borrow_records WHERE return_date IS NULL)
pred_sql: WITH RenewedReaders AS (SELECT DISTINCT reader_id FROM borrow_records WHERE renew_count >= 1), AllReturnedReaders AS (SELECT reader_id FROM borrow_records GROUP BY reader_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN return_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) SELECT r.name FROM readers r JOIN RenewedReaders rr ON r.reader_id = rr.reader_id JOIN AllReturnedReaders ar ON r.reader_id = ar.reader_id

question: 统计每个楼层的图书零借阅率
gold_sql: WITH loc_total AS (SELECT l.location_id, l.floor, COUNT(*) AS total FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id GROUP BY l.location_id, l.floor), loc_unborrowed AS (SELECT l.location_id, l.floor, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id WHERE b.book_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT book_id FROM borrow_records) GROUP BY l.location_id, l.floor) SELECT lt.floor, ROUND(COALESCE(lu.cnt,0)*1.0/lt.total,2) AS zero_borrow_ratio FROM loc_total lt LEFT JOIN loc_unborrowed lu ON lt.location_id = lu.location_id
pred_sql: WITH floor_book_counts AS (SELECT l.floor, COUNT(b.book_id) AS total_books FROM books b JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id GROUP BY l.floor), floor_borrow_counts AS (SELECT l.floor, COUNT(br.record_id) AS borrowed_books FROM borrow_records br JOIN books b ON br.book_id = b.book_id JOIN categories c ON b.category_id = c.category_id JOIN locations l ON c.location_id = l.location_id GROUP BY l.floor) SELECT fbc.floor, CASE WHEN fbc.total_books = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (fbc.total_books - COALESCE(fbc2.borrowed_books, 0)) * 100.0 / fbc.total_books END AS zero_borrow_rate FROM floor_book_counts fbc LEFT JOIN floor_borrow_counts fbc2 ON fbc.floor = fbc2.floor
